verdict.rationale: Base44 documents ways to access and modify the generated source (GitHub sync for local dev, CLI 'eject'/clone to download frontend+backend code, SDK, and bring-your-own-agent to the sandbox), but none of the evidence describes an in-builder code editor where a developer can view/edit raw source directly inside the Base44 UI — the documented workflows all require exporting to GitHub, a local project, or an external agent/sandbox connection. missing for 10: evidence of a native in-app code view/editor, confirmation that edits made externally sync back live into the builder UI, and any hands-on account of editing code within the builder itself.
